title: Metro Station Stop
lead: Your minecart rolls in, waits at the platform, and leaves when you press the button.

states.label: Waiting
states.text: The station is empty. The Copper Bulb is off, and the Powered Rail at the end has no power.

states.label: Train coming!
states.text: The cart rolls over the Detector Rail. The rail sends out power, and the Copper Bulb turns on.

states.label: At the platform
states.text: The Powered Rail has no power, so it works like a brake. The cart stops by the red buffer. The bulb stays on while it waits.

states.label: All aboard!
states.text: You press the button. The Powered Rail gets power and pushes the cart away from the buffer.

states.label: Off it goes
states.text: The cart rolls back over the Detector Rail. One more pulse, and the bulb turns off.

steps: Lay a straight track 5 blocks long: Rail, Rail, Detector Rail, Rail, Powered Rail.
Put a block of Red Concrete right after the Powered Rail. This is the buffer at the end of the line.
Put a Copper Bulb beside the Detector Rail, touching its side.
Put a Smooth Stone block beside the Powered Rail. Put a Stone Button on top of it.
Build your platform around the bulb and the button.
Join the open end of the track to your metro line. Then ride a Minecart in!
how: A Detector Rail sends out power while a minecart is on it. Each time it does, the Copper Bulb flips on or off. A Powered Rail with no power works like a brake. So the cart stops by the buffer. The button powers the block under it. That block powers the Powered Rail, and the rail pushes the cart away from the buffer.
tips: Keep a plain Rail between the Detector Rail and the Powered Rail. If they touch, the Detector Rail powers the Powered Rail. Then the cart bounces right back out.
A Copper Bulb stays the same until the next pulse. So it stays lit for as long as the cart waits.
A Powered Rail with power speeds a cart up. With no power, it slows the cart down and stops it.
